title: Zesty Brazilian Dried Cherry Ceviche
description: A bright, low‑fat ceviche that showcases dried cherries, a splash of cachaça flambe, and a silky Greek yogurt finish.
instructions: Rinse the dried cherries under cold running water and drain.
Soak the cherries in 15 ml of cold water for 5 minutes to soften, then drain again.
In a bowl whisk lime juice, cachaça, shallot, cilantro, salt, pepper, and Greek yogurt until smooth.
Fold in the softened cherries and stir gently to coat.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 15 minutes to meld flavors.
Heat a small skillet over medium heat and pour 12 ml of cachaça; ignite and let flare for 20 seconds.
Carefully pour the chilled ceviche into the skillet, letting the heat slightly caramelize the surface.
Stir the mixture quickly for 1 minute, then remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature.
Transfer the ceviche to chilled glasses, garnish with a sprig of cilantro and a few microgreens.
Serve immediately as a zesty, silky snack or light lunch.
